brand_voice: Warm, concise and practical. Speak as a helpful RetailMind product specialist, never as a robot. Use short sentences and plain language.

store_policies.title: Returns and refunds
store_policies.text: Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened products are eligible for return within 14 days if they are in original condition with all accessories. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of inspection.

store_policies.title: Shipping
store_policies.text: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50 and normally arrives in 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping arrives in 1 to 2 business days for a flat fee of $12. Orders placed before 2 PM on a business day ship the same day.

store_policies.title: Warranty
store_policies.text: All electronics include a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, cosmetic wear or normal battery degradation. Claims are handled by the support team with proof of purchase.

store_policies.title: Support hours and escalation
store_policies.text: Support is available every day from 8 AM to 8 PM local time. For account-specific issues, damaged items or warranty claims, offer to connect the customer with a human specialist.

products.name: RetailMind Studio Wireless Headphones
features: Replaceable ear cushions and folding case
products.details: Over-ear headphones tuned for balanced sound with soft memory-foam ear cushions. They weigh 250 g, fold flat for travel and include a USB-C charging cable.

products.name: RetailMind Brew Daily Coffee Maker
products.details: A compact drip coffee maker that brews a full pot in about 8 minutes. It includes a reusable mesh filter, a measuring scoop and a two-year limited warranty.

products.name: RetailMind Balance Yoga Mat
products.details: A durable TPE mat with a grippy surface on both sides. It wipes clean with a damp cloth, rolls up compactly and is suitable for yoga, pilates and home workouts.
